description: 🆕 B20 Asset tokens can post on-chain announcements (Announcement: id, description, uri) — issuer notices, corporate actions, redemptions — a channel ERC-20 has no equivalent for. Reads a token's announcement feed (active vs ended) from CDP-indexed events. The issuer-communications primitive for agents holding tokenized/RWA B20 assets.
name: b20_announcements

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.

data.description: The result payload. Shape is service-specific; every field is documented in the tool description.
